notes: Echo Clothing direct lookup optimization based on Essentials 3.9.35. Removes v3.9.36 coexistence throttles. Exact-match in-task AssetGet microcache when Echo Clothing is registered, with automatic suspension, controls and optional GL pipeline profiling. No claim of measured R133 FPS gain.

items: Installs an SDK AssetGet microcache only after detecting the running Echo Clothing Extension (not Echo Actions).
Successful exact-name asset references can be reused within the same JavaScript task, bypassing repeated downstream lookup hooks including Echo alias checks.
Never caches missing assets or redirected alias results; invalidates on asset registry changes and each microtask boundary.
Automatically suspends when repeated lookups are rare, and provides disable/enable controls and hit-rate statistics.
Optional read-only GL appearance rendering profiler, off by default.
Based directly on 3.9.35 and excludes all 3.9.36 Echo coexistence budgeting, registry/copy reuse, polling changes or visual throttles.
Does not change Echo canvas width, artwork dimensions, textures, permissions, native/BCX hooks or sync.
